clusters.mechanism: The stop condition is deferred until the last call's result is reconciled, so an unresolved (hanging) sixth identical call never triggers loop detection.
The previous-result-hash baseline is deleted when its call is evicted from the window, so a changed result is wrongly treated as a repeat of prior state.
The stop guard checks only the last call's result hash, so out-of-order completion of parallel calls triggers a loop stop before earlier results can show progress.
